atf-demo.aauth.dev — captured run
Captured: 2026-09-06 18:42 UTC
Node: v22.22.3   Resource: http://localhost:8787 (wrangler dev)
Agent provider: https://ap.atf-demo.local (local, harness/setup.mjs)

Every byte below is machine-produced. harness/setup.mjs mints the tokens;
client.mjs signs the requests and prints what it sent and what came back.

The appraisal behind these tokens is the committed evaluator output from
the summit repo with its validity window moved onto the current clock,
which invalidates the evaluator's signature over it. Nothing here verifies
that signature: the grade reaches the resource as the agent provider's
assertion, held on the provider's authority. See the note at the top of
harness/setup.mjs.

================================================================
0. What the resource says it requires
================================================================
$ curl -s http://localhost:8787/.well-known/aauth-resource.json
{
  "issuer": "http://localhost:8787",
  "access_mode": "agent-token",
  "name": "ATF Demo Resource",
  "description": "The relying party of the CSA Verifiable Agent Summit chain. It accepts an AAuth agent token carrying a signed ATF grade, verifies the agent provider and reads the grade the provider vouches for, then decides for itself. `GET /agent/echo` reports what it verified; `GET /api/summarize` applies the same gate and then challenges for a person token, because a qualifying level is eligibility for consideration and not permission.",
  "documentation_uri": "https://github.com/aauth-dev/atf-demo",
  "https://agentictrustframework.ai/policy": {
    "profiles": [
      "csa-atf:0.9.1"
    ],
    "minimum_level": "senior",
    "evaluators": [
      "https://demo.verifiedagents.ai"
    ],
    "status_channel": "https://demo.verifiedagents.ai/status/atf",
    "on_status_unreachable": "fail_closed"
  }
}

The ATF requirement lives under the namespace ATF owns. There is no
jwks_uri: this resource issues no tokens and signs no calls, so it
publishes no keys and holds no secret.

Refused by the signature check over the raw segments, before anything is
parsed out of them. The same refusal Imran's own verifier gives, and the
same registered code: the fix in summit PR #1, agreed on both sides.

Nothing is wrong with this token. It just does not carry what the
resource needs, and the agent can go and get one that does. The bare
challenge says an AAuth agent token is required; the Link relation points
at the document that says which profile and level. That the challenge
cannot say so itself is AAuth issue #145.

================================================================
Summary
================================================================
  valid      200  verification report
  tampered   401  Signature-Error: error=invalid_jwt
  no-atf     401  AAuth-Requirement: requirement=agent-token
  expired    401  Signature-Error: error=expired_jwt

Not shown here: atf_subject_mismatch, atf_appraisal_superseded and
atf_status_unavailable, the three refusals no fresh token repairs. They
need a contradicting claim, a published demotion event and a dead status
channel respectively, so they are covered in test/gate.test.ts rather
than by a client that only holds well-formed tokens.
